constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards, plans under 400 lines, Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no weakening, no type-ignore comments, no new per-file-ignores.
Raw detected values never persisted, logged, indexed, notified, returned or traced; only masked values and HMAC fingerprints.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests marked and skipped without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL.
Example configs use placeholders and secret references only; webhook secrets stay unset on active .env.example lines; test secrets built at runtime.
Conventions 7a: fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; mutation and superseded runs only in the Progress Log; build outputs to /tmp.
A defect found outside a plan's writePaths becomes a Reconciliation request in that plan's Progress Log, not an in-place fix.
p28b and p28c do not run whole-repository pytest; p29 runs it alone as the final gate because the 10,000-shard map-reduce test is load-sensitive.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Owner commit e24a433 fixed workflow notification recipients (telescreen.workflow.recipients) and EvidenceUploadExecutor registration; the earlier p24/p28b Reconciliation requests are resolved and must not be repeated.

architecture.md section 3 (run B4): evidence directory must be writable by the non-root image user via a named volume over an image-created, chowned /app/var/evidence; the example Police uses its own raw fingerprint key from POLICE_FINGERPRINT_KEY, not the Bureau's file: ref.
Waves B4-1 {p28b, p28c} (file-disjoint, no mutual imports) and B4-2 {p29} (serial, runs whole-repository gates).
intentionalTradeoffs: UI screenshot smoke (exit 2 without a browser) and docker compose config (no docker) are recorded as verificationGaps, not passes; static tests/examples checks still apply. They are therefore not listed in the must-pass verification arrays.
If whole-repository pytest fails only on the 10,000-shard test under load, p29 reruns it alone and then the full suite; only the final passing run is a verification entry.
supportedEdgeCases: SLA breach escalates a human task to the next tier via masked Slack (p28b).
Evidence with a credential is rejected (no file stored), then clean evidence accepted (p28b, p28c).
Police verify_remediation fails once (send-back) then passes (p28b).
Sweep removal reconciliation auto-resolves; partial sweep skips reconciliation; concurrent sweep returns 409 (p28b).
Separator-stripped sample variants searched in every sink; empty sinks fail the guard; scanner unavailable yields 503 (p28c).
Active .env.example file:/run/secrets/<name> refs must match compose top-level secrets (p29).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond the marked integration tests skipped offline.
Real external services (Slack, Google, GitHub, Anthropic, SMTP) and real docker compose up.
